create_Act_instance: create an Act instance with a specified activation function name and optional slope parameter
use_Act_forward_relu: use the Act forward method to apply ReLU activation to a PyTorch tensor
use_Act_forward_leaky_relu: use the Act forward method to apply leaky ReLU activation to a PyTorch tensor
use_Act_forward_softplus: use the Act forward method to apply softplus activation to a PyTorch tensor
use_Act_forward_ssp: use the Act forward method to apply shifted softplus activation to a PyTorch tensor
